modal.help_s1b: Whakahohea ngā Puku mō ngā pukapuka katoa, tāpiri ki te + Tāpiri kōpaki, tango ki te x, whakapiri rānei i ngā ara `;`-wehea ki Whakatika. Mā te huri ripa ka huri ngā kōpaki.
modal.help_s2b: Ingoa, Regex (wetereo Rust), Rangirua, Ihirangi kōnae, Glob (*.rs), Tētahi (OR) / Kaua tētahi (NOT), ngā rahi (pāti, 10M/1G rānei), ngā rā (YYYY-MM-DD), rārangi peke Whakakore, Toronga, tohu rōpū rānei (ka whakakapi, pāwhiri anō hei ūkui; ka whakatika ngā ritenga e Whakahaere), Warewarehia te pūmatua, Whakaatu huna.
modal.help_s3b: Pātene Matawai me te rapu nui, Enter rānei. Ka whakahaere anō te Whakahou me te pupuri i te tīpakonga. Ka whakahaere aunoatia e Live ngā whakatikahanga (kāore i te kā i te tuatahi). Kāore ngā rapunga wātea e oma — hoatu he * ki Glob mō ngā mea katoa.
modal.help_s4b: Ka kōmaka ngā pane iti, ka peke a Haere i ngā whārangi, ka whāngai ngā pouakataki i te Tārua ngā ara / Neke / Muku me ngā kaweake CSV–TXT–HTML–Excel–RTF. Ka whakahokia e ngā rapunga penapena me ngā whakaahua Nō nā tata nei ia tātari tae atu ki ngā kōpaki, OR/NOT, me te huna.
modal.help_keys_body: Ka rapu a Enter · ka waiho e Esc te arotahi / ka kati i ngā kōrero · ka neke te ↑/↓ i te tīpakonga · ka tohu te Space i te rarangi · ka neke te Tab i waenga i ngā mana.
